customCode.css: .in{animation:in .6s both}.rise{animation:rise .7s both}.draw{stroke-dasharray:2200;stroke-dashoffset:2200;animation:draw 3s .4s forwards}.slow{animation:slow 6s linear both}@keyframes in{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(35px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}@keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}@keyframes slow{from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.06)}}.headline{font-family:Playfair Display;font-size:70px;line-height:1.08;font-weight:700;color:#302b23}.body{font-family:Inter;font-size:30px;line-height:1.4;color:#3e382e}.date{font-family:Playfair Display;font-size:180px;line-height:1;color:#8d4e3d}.tag{font-family:Inter;font-size:21px;letter-spacing:4px;color:#665d4c}.move{animation:move 3s .7s forwards}@keyframes move{from{transform:translate(0,0)}to{transform:translate(-380px,-180px)}}
